pairs: For there is a judgment against you,
because you have become a trap for those you watched over,
and a net stretched out over Tabor.
And you have led astray victims into the depths,
though I am the teacher of them all.
et Israël non est absconditus a me:
and Israel has not been hidden from me,
yet now Ephraim has committed fornication,
Non dabunt cogitationes suas ut revertantur ad Deum suum,
They will not set their thoughts to return to their God,
quia spiritus fornicationum in medio eorum,
for the spirit of fornication is in the midst of them,
and they have not known the Lord.
Et respondebit arrogantia Israël in facie ejus,
And the arrogance of Israel will answer to his face.
et Israël et Ephraim ruent in iniquitate sua:
And Israel and Ephraim will fall in their iniquity,
and even Judah will fall with them.
With their flocks and their herds,
et in armentis suis vadent ad quærendum Dominum,
they will go to seek the Lord,
and they will not find him.
He has taken himself away from them.
They have sinned against the Lord.
For they have conceived sons that are strangers.
nunc devorabit eos mensis, cum partibus suis.
Now one month will devour them with all their own.
Ephraim in desolatione erit in die correptionis;
Ephraim will be in desolation on the day of correction,
for within the tribes of Israel, I have revealed faith.
Facti sunt principes Juda quasi assumentes terminum;
The leaders of Judah have become like those who assume the end.
super eos effundam quasi aquam iram meam.
I will pour my wrath over them like water.
Ephraim has been enduring malicious slander
because he began to go after filth.
And I will be like a moth to Ephraim,
and like decay to the house of Judah.
And Ephraim saw his own weakness,
and he sent to the Avenging king.
et ipse non poterit sanare vos,
But he will not be able to heal you,
nec solvere poterit a vobis vinculum.
nor is he able to release you from your chains.
For I will be like a lioness to Ephraim,
et quasi catulus leonis domui Juda.
and like a lion’s offspring to the house of Judah.
I myself will seize and go forth.
tollam, et non est qui eruat.
I will take away, and there is no one who can rescue.
I will go and return to my place,
donec deficiatis, et quæratis faciem meam.
until you shall grow faint and seek my face.
